She took time to ring me up after I'd left reception one day, to tell me she thought I'd been "rude and aggressive" (I hadn't, I was talking to her colleague, not even her, thru a screen when he'd gone over to a desk, asking him if he wanted me to read my writing for him off the note I passed him with repeat prescriptions.)
Previous to this, the same office manager rang me out of the blue and started telling me I needed to contact my old surgery to get them to send my records. I said 'was this something I was supposed to do'? No, it was the job of the previous surgery.  I said OK, well this is kind of why I changed surgeries (they were nice, just hard to get things done) and she started shouting about how she wasn't going to argue with me and I had to make these phone calls, -to do a GP admin task.. 🤷‍♀️..
It's bizarre. It may be because my accent isn't from this island even tho I'm Irish, that triggers her. I've seen other reviews mentioning the same theory, but theirs and my previous review have been deleted I now see..
These attacks both came as a surprise, and were so far out of line, that I changed surgeries because I could. I feel sorry for people who are stuck there taking her abuse. I asked the pharmacy she blamed for a script gone missing who to report her to, but they said office manager, and unfortunately she is the office
